text: Protime, a European specialist in workforce management and time registration, is part of SD Worx (SD Worx describes it as its subsidiary).
short: Protime is part of SD Worx.

source.name: SD Worx press release: SD Worx subsidiary Protime strengthens workforce planning offering and expands position in the Netherlands with acquisition of Checks
source.quote: Protime, a European specialist in workforce management and part of SD Worx, has acquired Checks.
